headword: {動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}

definitions.gloss: veterinary hospital; animal clinic; vet's office
definitions.explanation: A medical facility that provides healthcare for animals, especially pets. The standard term used in Japan for a veterinary practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧いった。
examples.english: I took the cat to the vet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new animal clinic opened in the neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具合|ぐあい}が{悪|わる}い→具合が悪い：22231_guaigawarui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れたい→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The dog is not feeling well, so I want to make an appointment at the vet today.

notes:
USAGE:
{動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん} is the standard everyday term for a veterinary clinic in Japan. Pet owners use this term regardless of the size of the facility. The abbreviated form {動物病院|どうぶつびょういん} is often seen on signs and business cards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れていく→連れていく：23753_tsureteiku⟧ (to take to the vet)
- {動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ (to go to the vet regularly)
- {動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ (the vet, the veterinarian)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{獣医|じゅうい}→獣医：07031_juui⟧: veterinarian (the profession)
- ⟦{獣医師|じゅういし}→獣医師：30766_juuishi⟧: veterinarian (formal title)
